<script>
(function () {
  // Only act on blog listing pages
  if (!/blog/i.test(location.pathname)) return;

  var COLS = 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))';

  function isCard(el) {
    if (!el || el.nodeType !== 1) return false;
    if (!/^(DIV|ARTICLE|LI|A)$/.test(el.tagName)) return false;
    return !!el.querySelector('img') &&
           !!el.querySelector('h1,h2,h3,h4,a,p');
  }

  function detectContainer() {
    var best = null, bestCount = 0;
    var scope = document.querySelectorAll('div,section,ul,main');
    for (var i = 0; i < scope.length; i++) {
      var parent = scope[i];
      var kids = [];
      for (var c = parent.firstElementChild; c; c = c.nextElementSibling) kids.push(c);
      if (kids.length < 2) continue;
      var cards = kids.filter(isCard);
      if (cards.length < 2) continue;
      if (cards.length < kids.length * 0.6) continue;   // must be mostly cards
      var tags = {};
      cards.forEach(function (k) { tags[k.tagName] = (tags[k.tagName] || 0) + 1; });
      var same = Math.max.apply(null, Object.keys(tags).map(function (k) { return tags[k]; }));
      if (same < 2) continue;                            // siblings must look alike
      if (cards.length > bestCount) { bestCount = cards.length; best = parent; }
    }
    return best;
  }

  function styleContainer(grid) {
    if (!grid) return;
    grid.style.setProperty('display', 'grid', 'important');
    grid.style.setProperty('grid-template-columns', COLS, 'important');
    grid.style.setProperty('gap', '28px', 'important');
    grid.style.setProperty('align-items', 'stretch', 'important');
    grid.style.setProperty('float', 'none', 'important');
    for (var c = grid.firstElementChild; c; c = c.nextElementSibling) {
      c.style.setProperty('width', 'auto', 'important');
      c.style.setProperty('max-width', 'none', 'important');
      c.style.setProperty('margin', '0', 'important');
      c.style.setProperty('float', 'none', 'important');
    }
  }

  function run() {
    try {
      var seen = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('.grid').forEach(function (g) {
        if (g.querySelector('img') && g.children.length >= 2) { styleContainer(g); seen.push(g); }
      });
      var found = detectContainer();
      if (found && seen.indexOf(found) === -1) styleContainer(found);
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  run();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', run);
  window.addEventListener('load', run);
  var scheduled = false;
  new MutationObserver(function () {
    if (scheduled) return; scheduled = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(function () { scheduled = false; run(); });
  }).observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  var n = 0, t = setInterval(function () { run(); if (++n > 20) clearInterval(t); }, 300);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  // GA4: Phone call tracking - fires website_calls (existing key event) on all tel: links
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var link = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href^="tel:"]') : null;
    if (link && typeof gtag === 'function') {
      gtag('event', 'website_calls', {
        phone_number: decodeURIComponent((link.getAttribute('href') || '').replace('tel:', '')).trim(),
        page_location: window.location.href
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
